Document 310
Foreign Relations of the United States, 1969–1976, Volume
                    E–7, Documents on South Asia, 1969–1972
310. Telegram 201141 From the
Department of
                                State
to the
Embassy in India
1
2
Washington
,
November 4, 1972, 0022Z
Subj:
Indian Debt Rescheduling
1.
USG
has decided to participate for
                                one year rpt one year in World Bank proposal for debt relief for
                                India with
US
share of $29.12
                                million.
2.
We have informed World Bank of this decision as part of our
                                continuing technical discussions with bank. Bank is informing
                                Indians and other AID-India Consortium members.
3.
Pending further guidance Embassy should avoid any interpretive
                                comment regarding this decision in discussions with Indian
                                officials. Embassy should not rpt not issue press statement and
                                should restrict response to possible press queries to simple
                                confirmation that decision made.
